// 3. Item browser
const IT = BROW.items; let shown = 40, selId = null;
$("#items-rule").innerHTML = "The page embeds " + IT.length + " of the " + BROW.n_items_total.toLocaleString("en") + " HARD items: every one of the " + BROW.n_discordant_benign + " benign items on which either model's refusal decision differs between English and Slovene, plus a seeded random sample (seed " + BROW.seed + ") of 150 of the other " + BROW.n_concordant_benign + " benign items and 120 of the " + BROW.n_harmful + " harmful items. Replies are cut at " + BROW.trunc_chars + " characters. Counts below describe this subset; the full-set rates are in the chart above.";
const isR = L => L === "REFUSE";
function pat(it, p){
  const g = it.r, ge = isR(g["gemma_it|EN_BT"].L), gs = isR(g["gemma_it|SL_MT"].L), me = isR(g["gams3_it|EN_BT"].L), ms = isR(g["gams3_it|SL_MT"].L);
  return p === "any" || (p === "g-sl" && gs && !ge) || (p === "g-en" && ge && !gs) || (p === "m-sl" && ms && !me) || (p === "m-en" && me && !ms);
}
function filtered(){
  const k = $("#f-kind").value, s = $("#f-src").value, p = $("#f-pat").value, q = $("#f-q").value.trim().toLowerCase();
  let L = IT.filter(it => (k === "all" || String(it.harm) === k) && (s === "all" || it.src === s) && pat(it, p) && (!q || (it.en + " " + it.sl + " " + it.en0).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0));
  const so = $("#f-sort").value;
  if (so === "len") L = L.slice().sort((a, b) => a.en0.length - b.en0.length);
  else if (so === "chrf") L = L.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.chrf == null ? 999 : a.chrf) - (b.chrf == null ? 999 : b.chrf));
  else L = L.slice().sort((a, b) => a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1);
  return L;
}
const SRC = {orbench_hard1k: "OR-Bench-Hard-1K", xstest: "XSTest", orbench_toxic: "OR-Bench toxic"};
function dots(it){ return CELLK.map(k => { const L = it.r[k].L; return '<span class="dot ' + L[0] + '" title="' + MODEL[k.split("|")[0]] + " " + (k.indexOf("SL") >= 0 ? "SL" : "EN") + ": " + L + '"></span>'; }).join(""); }
function drawItems(resetSel){
  const L = filtered(); const ul = $("#ilist"); ul.innerHTML = "";
  if (resetSel || !L.find(x => x.id === selId)) selId = L.length ? L[0].id : null;
  L.slice(0, shown).forEach(it => {
    const li = document.createElement("li"); const b = document.createElement("button"); b.type = "button";
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", it.id === selId ? "true" : "false");
    b.innerHTML = '<span class="dots" aria-hidden="true">' + dots(it) + '</span>' + esc(it.en0.length > 110 ? it.en0.slice(0, 110) + "…" : it.en0) + '<span class="meta">' + SRC[it.src] + (it.harm ? " · harmful" : " · benign") + (it.frag ? " · MT-fragile" : "") + "</span>";
    b.setAttribute("aria-label", it.en0.slice(0, 120) + ". Gemma EN " + it.r["gemma_it|EN_BT"].L + ", SL " + it.r["gemma_it|SL_MT"].L + "; GaMS3 EN " + it.r["gams3_it|EN_BT"].L + ", SL " + it.r["gams3_it|SL_MT"].L);
    b.addEventListener("click", () => { selId = it.id; $$("#ilist button").forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", x === b ? "true" : "false")); drawDetail(); });
    li.appendChild(b); ul.appendChild(li);
  });
  $("#imore").hidden = L.length <= shown;
  const k = $("#f-kind").value;
  const kindWord = k === "0" ? "benign" : (k === "1" ? "harmful" : "");
  $("#items-count").textContent = L.length + " matching " + (kindWord ? kindWord + " " : "") + "items; showing " + Math.min(shown, L.length) + ". Dots: Gemma EN, Gemma SL, GaMS3 EN, GaMS3 SL (red refuse, yellow partial, green comply).";
  drawDetail();
  // takeaway over the current kind/source/search (ignoring the pattern filter)
  const base = IT.filter(it => (k === "all" || String(it.harm) === k) && ($("#f-src").value === "all" || it.src === $("#f-src").value));
  const cnt = p => base.filter(it => pat(it, p)).length;
  const gs = cnt("g-sl"), ge = cnt("g-en"), ms = cnt("m-sl"), me = cnt("m-en");
  $("#t-items").innerHTML = "Among the " + base.length + " embedded " + (kindWord || "") + " items" + ($("#f-src").value === "all" ? "" : " from " + SRC[$("#f-src").value]) + ", Gemma refuses <b>" + gs + "</b> only in Slovene and <b>" + ge + "</b> only in English; GaMS3 refuses <b>" + ms + "</b> only in Slovene and <b>" + me + "</b> only in English. " + (gs > 1.5 * ge && k !== "1" ? "The asymmetry is Gemma's alone." : (k === "1" ? "On harmful items a Slovene-only refusal is a correct refusal, so these flips raise Gemma's hit rate too." : "No strong asymmetry in this slice."));
}
function drawDetail(){
  const box = $("#idetail"); const it = IT.find(x => x.id === selId);
  if (!it) { box.innerHTML = "<p>No item matches these filters. Try another decision pattern or clear the search.</p>"; return; }
  const col = (k, lang) => { const r = it.r[k]; return '<div><h4>' + (k.indexOf("SL") >= 0 ? "Slovene prompt" : "English prompt (baseline)") + ' <span class="badge b-' + r.L + '">' + r.L + '</span></h4><pre class="txt" lang="' + lang + '">' + esc(r.t) + '</pre></div>'; };
  box.innerHTML = '<h3 style="margin-top:0">' + SRC[it.src] + (it.harm ? ", harmful" : ", benign") + ' <span class="small"><code>' + esc(it.id) + '</code></span></h3>' +
    '<div class="pair"><div><h4>EN-BT prompt</h4><pre class="txt" lang="en">' + esc(it.en) + '</pre></div><div><h4>SL-MT prompt</h4><pre class="txt" lang="sl">' + esc(it.sl) + '</pre></div></div>' +
    '<p class="small">Original English: ' + esc(it.en0) + (it.chrf != null ? " · back-translation chrF " + f(it.chrf, 1) : "") + (it.frag ? " · flagged MT-fragile" : "") + '</p>' +
    '<div class="mrow"><h3>Gemma-3-12B-IT</h3><div class="pair">' + col("gemma_it|EN_BT", "en") + col("gemma_it|SL_MT", "sl") + '</div></div>' +
    '<div class="mrow"><h3>GaMS3-12B-Instruct (control)</h3><div class="pair">' + col("gams3_it|EN_BT", "en") + col("gams3_it|SL_MT", "sl") + '</div></div>';
}
["#f-kind","#f-src","#f-pat","#f-sort"].forEach(s => $(s).addEventListener("change", () => { shown = 40; drawItems(true); }));
$("#f-q").addEventListener("input", () => { shown = 40; drawItems(true); });
$("#imore").addEventListener("click", () => { shown += 40; drawItems(false); });

// 4. Forest over criterion rows (eval5)
function forest(host, rows, opts){
  const W = widthOf(host); const fs_ = FS(); const stacked = W < 620;
  const svgTmp = newSvg(host, W, 10, "");
  const lw = stacked ? 0 : Math.min(W * 0.45, measure(svgTmp, rows.map(r => r.label), fs_) + 12);
  const rowH = stacked ? 46 : 30; const mt = 10, mb = 44;
  const H = mt + rows.length * rowH + mb;
  const svg = newSvg(host, W, H, opts.aria);
  let lo = Math.min(-0.5, ...rows.map(r => r.ci[0])), hi = Math.max(0.5, ...rows.map(r => r.ci[1]));
  const T = niceTicks(lo, hi, W < 500 ? 4 : 6); lo = Math.min(lo, T.ticks[0]); hi = Math.max(hi, T.ticks[T.ticks.length - 1]);
  const ml = lw + 10, mr = 16; const iw = W - ml - mr;
  const x = v => ml + iw * (v - lo) / (hi - lo);
  T.ticks.forEach(t => { svgEl("line", {x1: x(t), x2: x(t), y1: mt, y2: H - mb, class: t === 0 ? "zero" : "gridline"}, svg);
    txt(svg, x(t), H - mb + 16, f(t, T.step < 0.5 ? 2 : 1), {"text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": fs_}); });
  txt(svg, ml + iw/2, H - 8, opts.xtitle, {"text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": fs_, class: "axis-title"});
  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const yc = mt + i * rowH + (stacked ? 32 : rowH/2);
    if (stacked) txt(svg, ml, mt + i * rowH + 13, r.label, {"font-size": fs_ - 1, fill: "#1b1b1b"});
    else txt(svg, ml - 10, yc + 4, r.label, {"text-anchor": "end", "font-size": fs_, fill: "#1b1b1b"});
    const g = svgEl("g", {}, svg);
    svgEl("rect", {class: "hit", x: ml, y: yc - rowH/2 + 2, width: iw, height: rowH - 4, fill: "transparent"}, g);
    svgEl("line", {x1: x(r.ci[0]), x2: x(r.ci[1]), y1: yc, y2: yc, stroke: r.color, "stroke-width": 3}, g);
    svgEl("circle", {cx: x(r.est), cy: yc, r: 6, fill: r.hollow ? "#fff" : r.color, stroke: r.color, "stroke-width": 2.5}, g);
    bindMark(g, r.tip, r.label + ": " + f(r.est, 2) + " " + ci(r.ci, 2));
  });
}
function drawForest(){
  const inv = $("#fo-invalid").checked; const sign = document.querySelector('input[name="fo-sign"]:checked').value;
  const rows = CRIT.rows.filter(r => inv || r.valid).map(r => {
    const est = sign === "harm" ? r.harm : r.orig, c = sign === "harm" ? r.harm_ci : r.orig_ci;
    const lab = r.body.replace("(iter 2, FINAL HARD)", "(HARD, unedited)").replace("eval2 meta (pooled RE-HKSJ, k=2)", "eval2 meta-analysis (k=2)");
    return {label: lab, est: est, ci: c, color: r.valid ? "var(--accent)" : "var(--bad)", hollow: !r.valid,
      tip: "<b>" + esc(r.body) + "</b><br>" + (sign === "harm" ? "harmonised " : "as reported ") + f(est, 2) + " " + ci(c, 2) + "<br>benign items: " + esc(r.twins) + "<br>judge: " + esc(r.judge) + "; dose: " + esc(r.dose) + "<br>" + esc(r.note)};
  });
  forest($("#c-forest"), rows, {aria: "Criterion-shift estimates across analyses", xtitle: sign === "harm" ? "Δc, harmonised (z units; negative = Gemma refuses more in Slovene)" : "Δc as each analysis reported it (z units; sign conventions differ)"});
  const valid = CRIT.rows.filter(r => r.valid); const below = valid.filter(r => r.harm_ci[1] < 0).length, above = valid.filter(r => r.harm_ci[0] > 0).length;
  const shownRows = CRIT.rows.filter(r => inv || r.valid); const sb = shownRows.filter(r => r.harm_ci[1] < 0).length, sa = shownRows.filter(r => r.harm_ci[0] > 0).length;
  let t = "Of the " + shownRows.length + " rows shown, <b>" + sb + "</b> have a harmonised interval entirely below 0 and <b>" + sa + "</b> entirely above. ";
  t += inv ? "The rows above 0 come from GaMS3's SL→EN cell, where it wrote Slovene in 0.00 of replies, so the manipulation failed there." : "Among compliance-valid rows the count is " + below + " of " + valid.length + " below zero and " + above + " above; the exception is Experiment 9. This count was a post-hoc refinement.";
  if (sign === "orig") t += " With each analysis's own sign convention the rows scatter on both sides of 0, which is why they had to be harmonised before comparison.";
  $("#t-forest").innerHTML = t;
}
$("#fo-invalid").addEventListener("change", drawForest);
$$('input[name="fo-sign"]').forEach(r => r.addEventListener("change", drawForest));

// 5. Language grid
let gModel = "gemma_it", gSel = null;
const LNG = ["en","sl","hu"], LN = {en:"EN", sl:"SL", hu:"HU"}, LFULL = {en:"English", sl:"Slovene", hu:"Hungarian"};
const gdose = $("#g-dose");
function fillDose(){ const lam = GRID.lambda[gModel]; const cur = gdose.value || "hi"; gdose.innerHTML = "";
  [["zero","Zero (λ = 0, unedited)"],["lo","Low (λ = " + lam[0] + ")"],["hi","High (λ = " + lam[1] + ")"]].forEach(o => { const e = document.createElement("option"); e.value = o[0]; e.textContent = o[1]; gdose.appendChild(e); });
  gdose.value = cur; }
tabs($("#g-model"), b => { gModel = b.dataset.v; fillDose(); drawGrid(); });
gdose.addEventListener("change", drawGrid); $("#g-kind").addEventListener("change", drawGrid);
const exIds = Object.keys(GRID.examples).sort(); const gex = $("#g-ex");
exIds.forEach(id => { const e = GRID.examples[id]; const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = id; o.textContent = id + ": " + (e.p.en || "").replace(/\s*Respond only in English\.?\s*$/, "").slice(0, 70); gex.appendChild(o); });
gex.addEventListener("change", drawCell);
function heat(v){ const a = [255, 245, 240], b = [127, 0, 0]; const t = Math.pow(v, 0.9); return "rgb(" + a.map((x, i) => Math.round(x + (b[i] - x) * t)).join(",") + ")"; }
function drawGrid(){
  const host = $("#c-grid"); const W = Math.min(widthOf(host), 560); const fs_ = FS();
  const dose = gdose.value, kind = $("#g-kind").value;
  const svg = newSvg(host, W, 10, "");
  const tw = measure(svg, ["EN","SL","HU"], fs_, 600);
  const ml = 8 + fs_ + 12 + tw + 8, mt = 46, mr = 6; const cw = (W - ml - mr) / 3; const ch = Math.min(cw * 0.72, 92); const H = mt + ch * 3 + 8;
  const s2 = newSvg(host, W, H, "Refusal rate grid for " + MODEL[gModel]);
  txt(s2, ml + cw * 1.5, 14, "Requested reply language", {"text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": fs_, class: "axis-title"});
  LNG.forEach((b, j) => txt(s2, ml + cw * j + cw/2, mt - 10, LN[b], {"text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": fs_, "font-weight": 600}));

data</a></li>\n</ul>\n</nav>\n\n<header class=\"hero\" id=\"top\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n<div class=\"kicker\">Interactive companion to the paper</div>\n<h1>Over-Refusal of Benign Slovene Prompts in Gemma-3-12B Is a Criterion Shift</h1>\n<p class=\"byline\">Gemma-3-12B-IT versus its Slovene-adapted sibling GaMS3-12B-Instruct. The paper gives no author line.</p>\n<div class=\"links\">\n<a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-2cf2a7-does-slovene-taught-refusal-survive@fork/run_spusA3PNmaY6/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n<a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-2cf2a7-does-slovene-taught-refusal-survive@fork/run_spusA3PNmaY6/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n<a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-2cf2a7-does-slovene-taught-refusal-survive/tree/fork/run_spusA3PNmaY6\">Code repository</a>\n</div>\n</div>\n</header>\n\n<main id=\"main\">\n\n<!-- ============================ FINDING ============================ -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"finding\" aria-labelledby=\"h-finding\">\n<div class=\"wrap finding\">\n<div class=\"prose\">\n<h2 id=\"h-finding\">The finding</h2>\n<p class=\"q\">The question</p>\n<p class=\"lead\">Gemma refuses more benign requests when they arrive in Slovene. Is that because it tells harmful from harmless less well in Slovene, or because it simply sets a stricter bar?</p>\n<p class=\"q\">The answer</p>\n<p>A stricter bar. On the reserved HARD set, unedited Gemma <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"over-refusal\">false-refuses</button> benign Slovene items at <b data-bind=\"F.1\"></b> against <b data-bind=\"F.0\"></b> in English, while GaMS3 stays at <b data-bind=\"F.2\"></b> in both languages. <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"sdt\">Signal-detection theory</button> puts the gap in the <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"criterion\">criterion</button>, not in <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"dprime\">sensitivity</button>:</p>\n<div class=\"bignum\"><span data-bind=\"didc\"></span> <small data-bind=\"didc-ci\"></small></div>\n<p class=\"small\"><button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"didc\">DiD<sub>c</sub></button>, 95% CI, in z units. The matching DiD on d′ is <span data-bind=\"didd\"></span> <span data-bind=\"didd-ci\"></span>.</p>\n<p><span class=\"rating\">ESTIMATE</span> The sign reverses when <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"partial\">PARTIAL</button> answers are counted as refusals. See <a href=\"#fails\">where it fails</a>.</p>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"card view\" id=\"v-sdt\">\n<p class=\"q\">Is the Slovene gap a threshold or a sensitivity effect?</p>\n<div class=\"controls\">\n<div>\n<span class=\"ctl-label\" id=\"lab-metric\">Quantity</span>\n<div class=\"seg\" role=\"tablist\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-metric\" id=\"sdt-metric\">\n<button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" data-m=\"F\" aria-selected=\"true\">False alarms F</button>\n<button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" data-m=\"H\" aria-selected=\"false\">Hits H</button>\n<button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" data-m=\"c\" aria-selected=\"false\">Criterion c</button>\n<button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" data-m=\"dprime\" aria-selected=\"false\">Sensitivity d′</button>\n</div>\n</div>\n<div>\n<label for=\"sdt-variant\">Item set and coding</label>\n<select id=\"sdt-variant\"></select>\n</div>\n</div>\n<div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>English (EN-BT, baseline)</span><span><i style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Slovene (SL-MT)</span></div>\n<div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-sdt\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Signal-detection bar chart\"></div>\n<div class=\"stats\" id=\"sdt-stats\"></div>\n<p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-sdt\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================ HOW ============================ -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"how\" aria-labelledby=\"h-how\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n<h2 id=\"h-how\">How it works: one benign item, start to finish</h2>\n<div class=\"prose\">\n<p>The walk-through follows one real OR-Bench item from Experiment 5. Every prompt, reply, judge label and log-probability below is the recorded value. Use the buttons, the stage markers, or the left and right arrow keys.</p>\n</div>\n<div class=\"stepper card\" id=\"stepper\" tabindex=\"-1\">\n<div class=\"pipe\" id=\"pipe\"></div>\n<div class=\"stepnav\">\n<button type=\"button\" id=\"st-prev\" aria-label=\"Previous stage\">&larr; Previous</button>\n<button type=\"button\" id=\"st-next\" aria-label=\"Next stage\">Next &rarr;</button>\n<span class=\"pos\" id=\"st-pos\"></span>\n</div>\n<p class=\"sr\" id=\"st-live\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n<div id=\"st-body\"></div>\n</div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================ EXPLORE ============================ -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"explore\" aria-labelledby=\"h-explore\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n<h2 id=\"h-explore\">Explore the evidence</h2>\n\n<div class=\"subview\" id=\"v-items\">\n<p class=\"q\">What does over-refusal look like on a single item?</p>\n<h3>Item browser: English and Slovene replies side by side</h3>\n<p class=\"prose small\" id=\"items-rule\"></p>\n<div class=\"controls\">\n<div><label for=\"f-kind\">Items</label><select id=\"f-kind\"><option value=\"0\">Benign (should be answered)</option><option value=\"1\">Harmful (should be refused)</option><option value=\"all\">All</option></select></div>\n<div><label for=\"f-src\">Source</label><select id=\"f-src\"><option value=\"all\">All sources</option><option value=\"orbench_hard1k\">OR-Bench-Hard-1K</option><option value=\"xstest\">XSTest</option><option value=\"orbench_toxic\">OR-Bench toxic</option></select></div>\n<div><label for=\"f-pat\">Decision pattern</label><select id=\"f-pat\">\n<option value=\"g-sl\">Gemma refuses in Slovene only</option>\n<option value=\"g-en\">Gemma refuses in English only</option>\n<option value=\"m-sl\">GaMS3 refuses in Slovene only</option>\n<option value=\"m-en\">GaMS3 refuses in English only</option>\n<option value=\"any\">Any pattern</option></select></div>\n<div><label for=\"f-q\">Search prompts</label><input id=\"f-q\" type=\"search\" placeholder=\"e.g. bank, poison, lock\"></div>\n<div><label for=\"f-sort\">Sort</label><select id=\"f-sort\"><option value=\"id\">Item id</option><option value=\"len\">Shortest prompt first</option><option value=\"chrf\">Lowest back-translation chrF first</option></select></div>\n</div>\n<p class=\"small\" id=\"items-count\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n<div class=\"browser\">\n<div><ul class=\"ilist\" id=\"ilist\" aria-label=\"Items\"></ul><button type=\"button\" class=\"btn more\" id=\"imore\">Show more</button></div>\n<div class=\"detail card\" id=\"idetail\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n</div>\n<p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-items\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"subview\" id=\"v-forest\">\n<p class=\"q\">Does the criterion shift show up outside Experiment 5?</p>\n<h3>Every criterion-shift estimate in the run, on one sign convention</h3>\n<div class=\"controls\">\n<label class=\"check\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"fo-invalid\"> Include rows that fail the language-compliance gate</label>\n<div><span class=\"ctl-label\" id=\"lab-sign\">Sign convention</span>\n<div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-sign\">\n<label class=\"opt\"><input type=\"radio\" name=\"fo-sign\" value=\"harm\" checked> Harmonised</label>\n<label class=\"opt\"><input type=\"radio\" name=\"fo-sign\" value=\"orig\"> As each analysis reported it</label>\n</div></div>\n</div>\n<div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>compliance-valid row</span><span><i style=\"background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--bad)\"></i>fails the 0.90 compliance gate</span></div>\n<div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-forest\"></div>\n<p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-forest\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"subview\" id=\"v-grid\">\n<p class=\"q\">After a partial English edit, does leftover refusal follow the prompt language or the reply language?</p>\n<h3>The 3 × 3 prompt-language × reply-language grid (Experiment 14)</h3>\n<div class=\"controls\">\n<div><span class=\"ctl-label\" id=\"lab-gm\">Model</span>\n<div class=\"seg\" role=\"tablist\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-gm\" id=\"g-model\">\n<button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" data-v=\"gemma_it\" aria-selected=\"true\">Gemma-3-12B-IT</button>\n<button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" data-v=\"gams3_it\" aria-selected=\"false\">GaMS3-12B-Instruct</button>\n</div></div>\n<div><label for=\"g-dose\">Edit dose</label><select id=\"g-dose\"></select></div>\n<div><label for=\"g-kind\">Items</label><select id=\"g-kind\"><option value=\"harmful\">Harmful (200 per cell)</option><option value=\"benign\">Benign (100 per cell)</option></select></div>\n</div>\n<div class=\"two\">\n<div>\n<div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-grid\"></div>\n<p class=\"small\">Select a cell to read one real reply from it. † marks a cell whose language compliance, pooled over the three doses, is below 90%.</p>\n</div>\n<div>\n<label for=\"g-ex\">Example harmful item (high dose)</label>\n<select id=\"g-ex\" style=\"width:100%\"></select>\n<div class=\"cellinfo\" id=\"g-cell\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n<div id=\"g-contrast\" class=\"stats\"></div>\n</div>\n</div>\n<p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-grid\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"subview\" id=\"v-dose\">\n<p class=\"q\">How much refusal is left at each edit dose, per language?</p>\n<h3>Dose-response of the English abliteration edit (Experiment 9)</h3>\n<div class=\"controls\">\n<div class=\"rangebox\"><label for=\"d-lam\">Dose λ: <output id=\"d-lam-out\" for=\"d-lam\"></output></label><input type=\"range\" id=\"d-lam\" min=\"0\" max=\"8\" step=\"1\" value=\"4\"></div>\n<fieldset style=\"border:0;padding:0;margin:0\"><legend class=\"ctl-label\">Series</legend>\n<label class=\"check\"><input type=\"checkbox\" data-s=\"gemma_it|en_bt\" checked> Gemma EN</label>\n<label class=\"check\"><input type=\"checkbox\" data-s=\"gemma_it|sl_mt\" checked> Gemma SL</label>\n<label class=\"check\"><input type=\"checkbox\" data-s=\"gams3_it|en_bt\" checked> GaMS3 EN</label>\n<label class=\"check\"><input type=\"checkbox\" data-s=\"gams3_it|sl_mt\" checked> GaMS3 SL</label>\n</fieldset>\n</div>\n<div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i class=\"line\" style=\"border-color:var(--blue)\"></i>Gemma EN</span><span><i class=\"line dash\" style=\"border-color:var(--blue)\"></i>Gemma SL</span><span><i class=\"line\" style=\"border-color:var(--amber)\"></i>GaMS3 EN</span><span><i class=\"line dash\" style=\"border-color:var(--amber)\"></i>GaMS3 SL</span></div>\n<div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-dose\"></div>\n<p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-dose\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================ TRY ============================ -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n<h2 id=\"h-try\">Try it: move the judge's threshold</h2>\n<div class=\"prose\">\n<p class=\"q\">Is the criterion shift a product of where the judge draws its line?</p>\n<p>The Qwen3-14B judge scored every reply by the log-probability of each label. The paper's readout takes the most probable label. Here you can demand more, or less, evidence before a reply counts as a refusal: a reply counts when its refusal margin is at least the threshold. The page recounts hits and false alarms over all 1,442 HARD items × 4 cells and recomputes H, F, d′, c and DiD<sub>c</sub> with the paper's formulas. At threshold 0 it reproduces the paper exactly; bootstrap intervals exist only there.</p>\n</div>\n<div class=\"card\">\n<div class=\"controls\">\n<div class=\"rangebox\"><label for=\"t-thr\">Refusal margin threshold (log-odds): <output id=\"t-thr-out\" for=\"t-thr\"></output></label><input type=\"range\" id=\"t-thr\" min=\"-10\" max=\"10\" step=\"0.5\" value=\"0\"></div>\n<div><span class=\"ctl-label\" id=\"lab-cod\">PARTIAL answers count as</span>\n<div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-cod\">\n<label class=\"opt\"><input type=\"radio\" name=\"t-cod\" value=\"mR\" checked> Not refusal (paper)</label>\n<label class=\"opt\"><input type=\"radio\" name=\"t-cod\" value=\"mRP\"> Refusal</label>\n</div></div>\n</div>\n<div class=\"two\">\n<div><div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i class=\"line\" style=\"border-color:var(--accent)\"></i>DiD<sub>c</sub> at each threshold</span><span><i style=\"background:var(--ink);border-radius:50%\"></i>current setting</span></div><div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-thr\"></div></div>\n<div class=\"tablewrap\"><table class=\"mini-table\" id=\"thr-table\" aria-live=\"polite\"></table></div>\n</div>\n<p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-thr-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================ FAILS ============================ -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n<h2 id=\"h-fails\">Where it fails</h2>\n<div class=\"prose\"><p class=\"q\">Which checks does the headline not survive?</p></div>\n<div class=\"card\">\n<div class=\"controls\">\n<label class=\"check\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"fx-only\"> Show only the checks that break the headline</label>\n</div>\n<div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>supports DiD<sub>c</sub> &gt; 0</span><span><i style=\"background:var(--bad)\"></i>breaks it (CI includes 0 or opposite sign)</span><span><i style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>placebo (should sit at 0)</span></div>\n<div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-fails\"></div>\n<p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-fails\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n<div class=\"prose\" style=\"margin-top:28px\">\n<h3>What the paper says it does not show</h3>\n<ul class=\"limits\">\n<li><b>The coding rule decides the sign.</b> Counting partial answers as refusals turns DiD<sub>c</sub> into <span data-bind=\"rp\"></span> <span data-bind=\"rp-ci\"></span>. Restricted to XSTest, it is <span data-bind=\"xs\"></span> <span data-bind=\"xs-ci\"></span>; the effect is carried by the OR-Bench items.</li>\n<li><b>The judge was never validated against humans.</b> The Qwen3-14B judge was calibrated against gemini-2.5-flash on DEV (κ 0.68–0.86). On edited rows, no judge exceeds κ = 0.51 against blind adjudication, and the readout gate has never passed. All adjudication is by an author-model LLM, not human review.</li>\n<li><b>The corroborating count is post hoc.</b> 8 of 9 compliance-valid rows point the same way, but that count was a refinement made after the frozen rule found an unresolved cross-body disagreement.</li>\n<li><b>Edited models are inconclusive.</b> Experiment 11's post-edit DiD<sub>c</sub> is 0.14 [−0.78, 1.12].</li>\n<li><b>The reply-language result has a weak anchor.</b> Gemma's raw OUT<sub>SL</sub> is <span data-bind=\"out\"></span> <span data-bind=\"out-ci\"></span>, but its PPI-corrected value is <span data-bind=\"ppi\"></span> <span data-bind=\"ppi-ci\"></span>. Experiment 16's PPI estimate of +2.43 [+0.89, +5.38] is capped at ESTIMATE because the harmful-content adjudicator κ is 0.12.</li>\n<li><b>GaMS3 ignores the reply-language instruction off the English-prompt row.</b> Its SL→EN compliance is 0.00, HU→EN 0.14, SL→HU 0.56, HU→SL 0.86, so GaMS3 mechanism claims are limited to the English-input row.</li>\n<li><b>Other limits.</b> Both models run in NF4 4-bit quantization; the Slovene prompts are machine translations that no native speaker audited; benign false-refusal adjudication uses 30 items per cell; Hungarian contrasts have a minimum detectable effect near 3 log-odds and are uninformative. Language-dependent over-refusal is partly anticipated by Addagada (2026) and Nguyen et al. (2026); the contribution is the signal-detection decomposition and the sibling-pair design.</li>\n</ul>\n</div>\n</div>\n</section>\n</main>\n\n<footer id=\"about\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n<h2>Links, ]

open(p,'w').write(s)
import re
used=set(re.findall(r'data-term=[\'"]([a-z]+)[\'"]', s)); gl=set(re.findall(r'\["([a-z-]+)","', s))
print("glossary without trigger:", gl-used)
EOF

I built `interactive.html`, a single self-contained page of 1.9 MB, in the paper folder. There was no message alongside the pasted prompt, so I treated the prompt as the task.

There were no console errors, no sideways scrolling and no overlapping chart labels. Every paper number the page shows matches `paper.tex` digit for digit, including DiD<sub>c</sub> +0.52 [0.38, 0.68], the false-alarm rates 0.364 / 0.569 / 0.273, the −0.31 reversal, and the reply-language grid values.

**What's on the page:**
- **The finding:** the question and answer, with a bar chart of false-alarm rate, hit rate, criterion and sensitivity per model and language. A selector switches between the 8 variants Experiment 5 recorded, such as XSTest only or partial answers counted as refusals.
- **How it works:** a 7-stage stepper that follows one real benign item that Gemma answers in English and refuses in Slovene. It runs from the source prompt through translation, the four model replies, the judge's log-probabilities and the cell counts, to DiD<sub>c</sub>.
- **Evidence:**
  - An item browser over 850 of the 1,442 items, with filters and English and Slovene replies side by side. It holds every item where either model's decision flips between languages, plus seeded samples of the rest; the page states this rule.
  - A chart of all 11 criterion-shift estimates across the run, which shows the paper's "8 of 9".
  - The 3×3 prompt-language × reply-language grid, where clicking a cell shows a real reply.
  - The dose-response curves, with a slider over the 9 recorded doses.
- **Try it:** a slider moves the judge's refusal threshold over the recorded per-item scores, and the page recomputes the rates and DiD<sub>c</sub> live. At threshold 0 it reproduces the paper's values and intervals exactly; the extraction script checked this.
- **Where it fails:** a toggle that isolates the checks that break the headline, followed by the paper's own limitations.
